line.comment: * Returns the crafting cost, or recycle value if recycling, of a ship.
* Mordan4: Renegades plot completion grants +10 specialization.
* ZH 2.0: Four construction resources, including Crystals. 75 was chosen to increase the cost by 33% (50/100 -> 50/75)
* ZH 1.10: OCV signal strength affects manufacturing.
* Add-Ons 1.6.1: Supply penalties affect player manufacturing.
* Each entry contains numerator and denominator.
* Xenon: Half Computer Components and Hull Plating,
* half Hull Plating and Quantum Tubes.
* OCV signal discount applies to manufacturing only.
* Ships use the full recycling factor.
